adoption_minimums.native_seam: Z80 selective-admission contract (admitted-start set, typed unadmitted-PC behavior, validator) - absent today

attribution: roots = A->B; byte labels/edge-aware/PAD = B->B1 (cell 32, max); context+two-scale = B1->D256/D512; hard-positive = D512->D512HP; cell size = cell32->cell16 for the same scores
candidate_selection: among {B1,D256,D512,D512HP} x cell {32,16} x agg {max,top2}: lowest development mean retained fraction at full recall (roots included); ties by lexicographic key
conditional_stages: native Z80 selective admission only after sealed_success and economics; launcher SMS Optimized only after native admission; otherwise neither is built

discarded_candidates.castle_of_illusion,taz_mania,wonder_boy_: no public source-backed disassembly; unlabelled economics probes only
discarded_candidates.sonic2_sms: same engine family as Sonic 1; local cartridge is a different revision
discarded_candidates.tunnel: Game Gear target; asset conversion tools unavailable

evaluation: leave-one-lineage-out over the 8 development lineages; per lineage: positive cells, full FRF, residual FRF after roots, retained fraction at full recall, retained for 50/90/99/99.9% recall, c_outside_r, worst residual ranks, per-seed residual FRF and its population std-dev
fixed_budget: B_fixed = ceil_to_0.05(max over development folds of residual FRF of the selected candidate + 0.05); no adaptive estimator is developed or reused (the SEG-051 fraction(sigmoid>=0.5) rule is not validated)

gates.development_strict: B_fixed <= 0.65 and zero uncovered positive cells on every development fold at B_fixed
gates.economics: projected build CPU = -3.0 + 2.441 s/KiB * retained * KiB (ADR 0116 model, a projection until a native producer is measured); gate: reduction >= 20% on the sealed mean; real economics measured after native integration
gates.improvement_label: CNN_GENERALIZATION_IMPROVED if the best candidate lowers the development mean retained fraction at full recall by >= 0.10 absolute versus B refit on the same folds and does not raise the worst-lineage value
gates.sealed_condition: sealed cohort is opened only if development_strict passes; selected candidate refit once on all 8 development lineages; sealed scored exactly once (marker file)
gates.sealed_success: every source instruction-start cell of each sealed lineage inside R at B_fixed (any miss = failure) and mean sealed retained fraction (roots included) <= 0.65

models.A: historical SEG-051 C1 without roots (retained OOF scores for 6 lineages; refit with the unchanged trainer on the 8 SEG-056 folds)
models.B1: C1 trunk (embedding16, 4x conv k5 dil 1,2,4,8, 32ch; radius 30) with a dense per-byte head: isolates byte-level labels, edge-aware windows and the PAD token
models.D256: two-scale: local path (2x conv k5, 24ch) + context path (stride-4 conv, residual dilated conv k5 dil 1,2,4,8,16; radius 250 bytes) fused by 1x1 conv, dense per-byte logit
models.D512HP: D512 trained with the single pre-registered hard-positive reweighting w = pos_weight*(1+2*(1-sigmoid(z)).detach()) on positive bytes

order_statement: This plan, its digest, the structural-root definition and the trainers/evaluators are committed and pushed before any SEG-056 model is fitted or any SEG-056 held-out result is computed. The six SEG-051 development lineages were exposed by SEG-051 and are NOT blind evidence; the two new SDCC lineages were never seen by any model. The three sealed lineages are not opened (images or labels) for design.
policy: R = structural root cells UNION top ceil(B*cells) ranked cells; retained fraction = |R|/cells (root overhead included)

aggregators: top2 (mean of the two largest byte logits)

secondary_label: CNN_GENERALIZATION_IMPROVED may qualify a Z80_ML_RECALL_BLOCKED primary outcome

split.rule: sealed set carried over unchanged from SEG-051 (sha256 order, fixed before any model existed); new lineages are development only

addresses: 0x0038 maskable interrupt (IM1; IM0 reads RST 38h on SMS)
structural_roots.correction: the SEG-051 post-hoc diagnosis used cells {0,1,2}; the architectural set is {0,1,3} at 32 bytes
structural_roots.excluded: RST 08h..30h and image-start bytes are not entries
structural_roots.mapping: image offset == CPU address for these (first 1 KiB of ROM is permanently mapped on the Sega mapper)

training.loss: masked binary cross-entropy over labelled bytes; pos_weight = mean over training lineages of negative/positive labelled bytes
training.sampling: uniform over training lineages (independent-lineage balanced); window starts include image edges (edge-aware)

unit.context: cells are decision units only; the model sees MARGIN=512 bytes either side with a distinct PAD token outside the image
